title: Multi-phase fee totals miscalculated in table

source_text:
Fee table totals don't add up on multi-phase engagements

Repro: Meridian brief, two phases at 48,000 and 36,000. Generated total renders as 92,000. Should be 84,000. Happens on any brief with more than one phase.
